drafts.angle: The $0.10 reviewer (rides @OfficialLoganK's Gemini Decision 1 launch: price in line two, native video and PDF)
drafts.draft_en:
$0.10 per 1M input tokens.

Native image, audio, video, and PDF.

That's not a model price. That's the end of 'we can't afford to review every ad.'

Every creative, every variant, every market, checked against brand rules, legal claims, and platform policy before it ships.

The cost excuse is gone. The only question left is whether your review step exists.

That's what we're building at Aubric.
drafts.video_tip: 20s vertical. Open on the price '$0.10 / 1M tokens' full-screen for 2 seconds, then a fast montage of 50 ad thumbnails (image, video, audio waveform, PDF one-pager) flowing into an Aubric queue, each landing with an APPROVE, FIX, or BLOCK badge. End card: 'The cost excuse is gone.' Post today while Decision 1 is still the launch everyone's quoting.

drafts.angle: Show the full setup (rides @gregisenberg's 'Grok Bot is the BEST AI agent orchestrator... here is the FULL setup', 769K in 17 hours)
drafts.draft_en:
Everyone's sharing their agent orchestrator setup this week. Here's the step most of them skip.

My stack at Aubric:
1/ Agents write and ship code
2/ Agents generate ad creative
3/ Agents schedule and post
4/ One agent checks every asset against brand, legal, and platform rules before step 3

Without step 4 you're not orchestrating. You're automating risk.

Happy to share how we wired it up.
drafts.video_tip: 45s screen recording, vertical crop. Hook in the first 2 seconds: 'The step every agent setup is missing.' Walk the four steps as a numbered overlay, then pause on step 4 and show a real batch where one ad gets flagged with the exact rule cited. Mirror Greg's 'FULL setup' framing: show the actual screen, no slides.

drafts.angle: Counter-hype one-liner (rides @rauchg's 'still requires... human focus... And an attention span', 3.7K likes)
drafts.draft_en:
AI can make 1,000 ads by lunch.

It still takes a human to decide which one is true.
